description_text:
Cradle 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 8737 vertices, 8164 quad faces (16328 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
A couch / sofa 3D Model, nr. 4 in my collection. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, and non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name. PBR Textures files are included in a subfolder in the BLEND archive, along with scene files.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material (in the Blender Cycles scene), UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter 2.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 75376 vertices, 75350 quad faces (150700 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha, normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just drag-and-drop the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Low poly wooden dresser that was created using Blender.
This model uses a diffuse map for the colors, a gloss map to give certain parts a reflective and shiny surface, and an AO map for calculating shadows. The diffuse map was made from a wooden texture that was made using GIMP. Also included is a combined texture which combines the diffuse, gloss and AO maps together. The UV Layout of the UV Map is also included to show how the texture maps are laid out. This model can be purchased separately or in the Bedroom Furniture Asset Pack.
Features:

  - Model is exported in 4 file formats (FBX, OBJ, 3DS, DAE/Collada)

  - Textures are in PNG format

  - Textures are 2048x2048

  - Object has been unwrapped and its textures are baked to its UVMaps

  - 4 separate archive files for each exported file format along with their textures

  - All preview images were rendered using the cycles engine and were exported into PNG format

Included Textures:

  - DresserCombinedTexture

  - DresserDiffuse

  - DresserGloss

  - DresserAO

  - DresserUVLayout

description_text:
Increasingly these days more and more things come to you in pouches; petfood, human food, hair colouring, cooking sauces, the list goes on and on.  Although they may be excellent for 'the environment' the one problem they still share with traditional cans and bottles is that there will always be a little bit left in the pouch and in these days when we're encouraged to save as much as we can that little bit of waste can mount up.
Therefore I designed this, the Pouch Squeezer.  It acts roughly like a pair of hair straighteners; you squeeze a little out of the pouch by hand then close the jaws of the squeezer around it, hold onto the bottom of the pouch and slowly drag the squeezer upwards.  This will force the contents of the pouch out and into whatever you're emptying it into, wringing absolutely as much as possible out of the pouch and eliminating that small bit of waste.  It has been tested and works brilliantly on toothpaste tubes, food pouches, hair-product pouches and even paint and oil tubes (although it's not really suitable for aggressive solvents such as acetone, as it will tend to dissolve...)
I actually designed it to be used with catfood pouches; my moggies love catfood in gravy but the last thing I could handle first thing in the morning was cold gravy all over my fingers when I was feeding them.  Therefore I took the designer route and thus the Pouch Squeezer was born!  The open back of the jaws traps any splashing from the catfood which means no gravy'd fingers and it can be easily washed up after use.
The jaws of the Squeezer are 100mm wide, so they obviously can be used with any pouch up to that width.  But if your pouch is wider just squeeze one half and then the other; your fingers will stay clean!
The Pouch Squeezer is available, printed and assembled, in my Etsy store - www.etsy.com/uk/shop/enterprisexddesign

description_text:
Drawers can be built in a variety of manners using a variety of materials. Wood and various wood composites, sheet metal, and plastic are common materials used for drawers and the furniture that the drawer is contained in.
Wooden drawers are often designed so that the front face is complete and the end grain from the side pieces does not show. The corners may be dovetailed for additional strength or for aesthetics,[1] and a half-blind dovetail joint may be used for the front corners to hide the joint. To attach the bottom piece of the drawer, a groove may be cut in the four vertical pieces to insert the bottom of the drawer. Most commonly, one or two handles or drawer pulls are attached to the front face of the drawer to facilitate pulling it out from its enclosure. In some cases, drawers may have another means by which to pull it, including holes cut in the front face or a hollowed-out area to insert the fingers on the bottom side of the front face of the drawer.
Some drawers incorporate a locking mechanism to secure the drawer. This is commonly found in filing cabinet and desk drawers. Most older or inexpensive pieces of furniture and cabinets use wooden sliders, upon which the drawer slides as it is opened or closed. Wood slides can be lubricated with paraffin wax. Newer furniture and cabinets may use plastic friction slides, or more elaborate bearings slide, which will provide smoother operation with less binding. There are different types of bearing slides, such as linear ball-bearing slides, roller bearing slides, progressive action slides. Modern drawer slides are usually categorized in how they are mounted, including center mount, side mount, bottom mount and European mount drawer slides. Drawer slides are intended for use varying from light to heavy drawers and thus contain load ratings ranging from 75–450 pounds (34–204 kg). A load rating of 100 pounds (45 kg) is considered typical.[citation needed]
Drawer slides often have a mechanism to keep the drawer from accidentally being pulled fully from its enclosure.

description_text:
Two drawers bedside table 3D Model. 3 individual objects (frame, upper drawer, lower drawer), sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
3 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 4320 vertices, 4270 quad faces (8540 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

--General--
3D Model of a Night Table. Native format: Blender
--Geometry--
Everything is named and  packed  into an empty. this will make it easier for you to animate it. The model is made out of polygon. In Blender I have turned on the subdevision-surface modifier, which can easily be turned off to get less polys.
--Rendering--
The model comes with no ligtening set up. No 3rd party plugin needed Ready to render. Rendering for the preview prictures was done with the Cycles Render Engine (Nodes in the Blend File included).
--Scale--
This scene is modeled in real world scale. As I said, you can reduce the number of faces easyily by just turning off the sub-division-surface-modifier.
If you got any questions on this model just pm us, we will reply as soon as possible.
Created by Nele Woelk and Norman Jauchen

Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 1974 vertices, 1956 quad faces (3912 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

Vessel 302 Vase is a traditional shape twisted up to create sweeping lines from top to bottom. Place it on your desk in your home or office with a few flowers.

  - The included STL file is set to the recommended print size in millimeters (64.37 x 64.379 x 149.99).

  - STL model file consists of 94,208 triangular polygons.

  - Other model files consist of 47,104 quadrangular polygons for easier editing.

  - No supports are required for a successful print using this model.

  - Model has been tested repeatedly for printability; see images above for examples of what to expect as a final product.

  - Completely watertight geometry; no gaps or loose polygons

  - Recommended layer height: .15mm/150 microns

  - Recommended infill: 10%

  - Recommended print speed: 60-80mm/s

  - Recommended travel speed: 100-120mm/s

description_text:
Furniture pack including eight sleek, original nightstand models for use in your modern bedroom renders! The models are ready-to-go, with both materials and real-world measurements taken care of. Just append the .blend, and you're on your way. I sincerely hope you enjoy this product, and if you make something cool with it, I would love to see it. Cheers!
P.S. The relatively high poly count is due to the fact that a) the number applies to all eight models and b) the bevel added to models are fairly detailed. Hope that clears things up! Also, this is actually the first time I post on here, so if there's anything wrong with the files (they're corrupted, not downloading etc.) please tell me right away and we'll sort it out! I want you to be happy with your purchase and feel that it was money well spent.
HOW TO USE: 

  - Unzip the file to wherever you want to store it. 

  - Open the Blender project where you wish to insert the pack. 

  - Click File>Append and click through to the Nightstands Pack 1 folder. 

  - Select the folder, then the project. Afterwards, select the folder Collections, and finally select the Nightstands Pack 1 collection. 

  - You're done! The pack has now been added as a separate collection in your project.

description_text:
The Woolworth Building is a 792ft (241m) tall skyscraper in New York City. The building was completed in 1913 as the tallest building in world, a title it held for over 25 years. Designed by legendary architect Cass Gilbert, it was designed in an exquisite Gothic Revival style. Its design was heavily influenced by European cathedrals, leading to the tower being nicknamed the Cathedral of Commerce. It notably was built before the introduction of the 1916 Zoning Law, which mandated the setbacks that characterize many of New York's most iconic skyscrapers. Gilbert and Woolworth shaped the building with soon-to-be ubiquitous setbacks to allow sunlight to reach City Hall Park below. While today the building is far from the tallest building in the city and Woolworth's stores have disappeared, the Cathedral of Commerce still stands as one of New York's most recognizable and beloved skyscrapers. In recent years, its upper floors have been converted to ultra-luxury condos.
Because this building is particularly tall, there are 2 ways to print it. One file (WoolworthComplete.stl) contains the entire building in one piece. Another option is to print the building in 2 pieces, separated roughly halfway up the tower portion (WoolworthPart1.stl and WoolworthPart2.stl).
(NOTE: This model, originally listed in 2019, has been completely redone and updated in February 2021.)

description_text:
The Old City Hall is a medieval landmark in the heart of Prague's Old Town Square (Staré Město). The 70m (230ft) tall gothic tower was completed in the mid-14th century and features the famous astrological clock. Connected to the clock tower are several buildings dating back to the Renaissance. On the tower's northern side are the remains of the Old City Hall's north wing, which was destroyed by a fire during the Prague Uprising at the end of World War II. The collection of buildings that make up Prague's Old City Hall is one of the most famous and most popular pieces of history in Prague and in Europe as a whole.
This model was designed for small-scale printing (Between 1:1000 and 1:1333 scale, making the tower ~52-70mm (2 - 2.5 inches) tall).

Carefully calibrated in its dimensions, the MOS bench by GamFratesi has a double function as a seat and a container with open shelf. description_text:
Airport seating chairs 3D model + damaged model for free

  - Organized scene with detailed layers (collections) and passes

  - Clean topology and high resolution textures

  - Ready to be freely used in all context (both in personal and comercial projects)

Model includes:  2 types  of 3D model with clean topology (new & damaged - as a bonus model for free), high quality model to add extra realism to final render, well for close-up renders, PBR texturing with high-resolution maps (Diffuse, Roughness, Metal/Specular, Normal and Opacity maps), all texture maps are packed into program files for straight forward usage + (in case, all texture maps are provided for needs), minimized Poly counts without losing quality of model, and almost all 3D software formats are supported for easy competability.

  - New model - all softwares

  - Damaged - all softwares include damaged chair without environment (environment is provided in Blender file)

SOFTWARES:

  - Stereolithography - .stl

  - Wavefront - .obj

  - Collada - .dae

  - Autodesk FBX - .fbx

  - Autodesk 3DsMax - .max (native file)

  - Autodesk Maya - .maya (native file)

  - Cinema4D - .c4d (native file)

  - SketchUp - .skp (native file)

  - Blender 2.79 or newer - .blend (native file)

  - and others:    .glTF;    .x3D

Additional: All color variations from last preview renders can be provided on request. For further information fill free to contact and leave your opinions in comments...

description_text:
3D model of the modular bio-engineered alien base.
The design of the base is inspired by the bio-engineered forms and shapes. The model is modular and it contains 17 different segments which can be used to create uniqe alien bases in the forms of labyrinths.
The main types of segments include:

  - Large Main Central Hall

  - Straight corridor segment

  - Curved corridor segment type 1 

  - Curved corridor segment type 2

  - Curved corridor segment type 3

  - Corridor crossing junction - 4 ways

  - Corridor crossing junction - 3 ways

  - Corridor ending

  - Entrance to the base

Each of the segments has defined separate light sources which illuminate particular modular area. Material of the base is defined using noise and musgrave textures combined for the roughness, reflectivity and bumpiness of the surface. Light are defined as an area lights. There is simple volumetric fog added to the main hall segment. Segments can be easiliy connected to each other in different ways to create custom labyrinths, one of the version of the base is presented in the attached pictures. Mesh of the segments is subdividable and it starts looking smooth by using level 1 of the subdivision, but it is reccomended to use at least level 2 of the sub-division modifier to achieve nice smooth wall surfaces.  Mesh of the individual segments is designed to be sub-divided using already set sub-division modifier. The minimum level of the sub-division which should be used in this model is 1, reccomended is 2 and for the users who have good PCs even 3.
The blender file is divided into few scenes of which two are used for the mian purposes. One which contains corridor segments used to create labyrinth parts of the alien base, and the second  one which contains main hall segment. Main hall segments and corridor segments can be connected freely which results in the creation of the various, interesting bases which differs from each other. The curved corridor type 3 is used to connect two levels of the base. The height of the single level is defined to be exactly 3.8 meters and it is the main modular vertical dimension of the base. The single segment is defined to be exact 10.2 meters long an it is the main modular horizontal dimension of the base. 
During the merging process of the segments it is reccomended to merge vertices at the connections between individual segments and joining segments together to allow the usage of the sub-division modifier on the whole base. 
REMEMEBER THAT ALL ELEMENTS OF THE BASE ARE STORED IN DIFFERENT SCENES IN THE BLENDER FILE.
THE MODEL IS DESIGNED TO BE USED BY BLENDER USERS ONLY DUE TO ITS MODULAR NATURE AND THAT THE PROCESS OF CONNECTING SEGMENTS IS DESIGNED TO BE EXECUTED USING BLENDER TOOLS BUT THE FINAL VERSIONS OF THE BASE CREATED IN BLENDER MAY BE USED IN OTHER SOFTWARE.

description_text:
The Manhattan Municipal Building is a 580ft (177m) tall skyscraper in New York City. Located at 1 Centre Street in Lower Manhattan, the building towers over City Hall Park. The building was constructed in 1914 to house the offices of the city, whose recent consolidation of its boroughs demanded larger administrative facilities. It's design, the work of prominent firm McKim, Mead & White, is a unique spin on a Neoclassical Style. Atop the building's lofty crown stands a 25ft (7.5m) tall golden statue titled Civic Fame, designed by Adolph Alexander Weinman. At the street level, a large colonnade adorned with engravings commemorating the history of New York guards the tower's entrance. Behind the grand entrance gate is a 4-story tall archway that runs underneath the building's central tower to a public plaza surrounded by multiple government facilities.
Because of the building's large size and unusual geometry, there are multiple ways to print this building. The colonnade and archway at the base of the building features many freestanding columns. Many 3D printers may run into issues getting these columns to adhere to the build plate properly. Because of this, there is an STL file that connects the columns to the rest of the structure on the first few layers to aid with adhesion.It is also possible to print the building in 2 pieces, separated at the 25th floor. This may be ideal for those who have smaller printers or those who wish to print the tower in finer detail than the rest of the building.

description_text:
Based on a scene from Asterix in Switzerland, where rows of such objects form a council chamber's amphitheatric seating.The desk was imagined as two types of wood (a dark wood for the base with a lighter hue for contrast). Textures are not included, but materials are set so you can easily plug in any textures you find interesting.
The model can be used either as a standalone piece of furniture (for example, to furnish an office or courthouse scene) or as a basic component in an amphitheatre, as shown in the renders. The array modifiers are set but not applied in the .blend file,  so they can be tweaked and varied according to taste, creating different layouts.Also included in the .blend file are: a tiered platform upon which the desks are set; and a wooden railing that runs along the top of the amphitheatre.
There are .fbx and .obj files both for the individual desk and the full amphitheatre.
Made with Blender 2.8

A parametric sofa that can be used in your applications, games, real-time renders.
Parametric furniture is starting to gain momentum in terms of popularity with the consumer.
What is parametric furniture?Parametric furniture is called a multilayer plywood structure. Plywood used in the production of parametric furniture is different. The species of wood that makes up plywood can be completely different. These are birch, aspen, maple, linden and other tree species.    Parametric style is a new trend in the design of premises and architectural structures. It is distinguished by smooth flowing lines, unusual shapes, realistic 3D volume and unique design. This style began to develop actively in the 21st century and showed itself to the maximum in the interior of various premises: museums, studios, restaurants, private houses. This style brought with it a lot of space, freedom, originality and uniqueness.

This is a model of a Modern Entrance Door(metal-wooden). Originally created with Blender 2.93.
#SPECS
This model contains 2 separate object groups for Door and Frame. No subdivision is required.Hinges provided with door are concealed hinges.
vertex count--Door-4540Door+frame-12910
4k textures are provided in zipped file.This model contains Blender Cycles materials. Other formats (.FBX and .OBJ) are exported with material but you may need to reassign glass material.

All preview images are rendered with Blender Cycles Renderer. Product is ready to render. Render setup is included as a separate Blender file, which is needed to produce images that match the thumbnails.
#Dimentions
Model is built to real-world scale (1m*2.25m*0.09m). You can Scale model to fit your requirement.
#ADDITIONAL NOTES
Other than blend file formats (.FBX and .OBJ) may be need glass material to reassign.

A parametric chair that can be used in your applications, games, real-time renders.
Parametric furniture is starting to gain momentum in terms of popularity with the consumer.
What is parametric furniture? Parametric furniture is called a multilayer plywood structure. Plywood used in the production of parametric furniture is different. The species of wood that makes up plywood can be completely different. These are birch, aspen, maple, linden and other tree species. Parametric style is a new trend in the design of premises and architectural structures. It is distinguished by smooth flowing lines, unusual shapes, realistic 3D volume and unique design. This style began to develop actively in the 21st century and showed itself to the maximum in the interior of various premises: museums, studios, restaurants, private houses. This style brought with it a lot of space, freedom, originality and uniqueness.

description_text: The Pabst Building was a 14-story  skyscraper in Milwaukee, Wisconsin built in 1891. In order to put his mark on the city, Frederick Pabst commissioned Chicago-based architect Solon Spencer Bemen to design the corporate headquarters of his namesake brewery. The building was designed in a striking style that combined Romanesque and Flemish Renaissance Revival architecture to reflect Milwaukee's flourishing German-American population, one of the largest concentrations of German immigrants anywhere in America at the time. This unique style came to define the city's architectural character for decades to come, with architects mimicking the look in buildings across the city, most notably in the Milwaukee City Hall. Tragically, the building was never adequately maintained and gradually fell into disrepair; the copper rooves needed to be removed by the middle of the 20th century. In 1981, the scarred building was finally demolished to make way for 100 East Wisconsin, a 1989 skyscraper that took many architectural cues, adapted to a postmodern style, from the Pabst Building.This model aims to recreate the building as it once stood in its full glory.

description_text:
Description:This kitchen chair is a high quality model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your home and interior furnishing rendering 
projects. The chair has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modelled in 3ds Max 
2014 and rendered with V-Ray. 
Features:-High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.-Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh 
resolution if necessary.)-All colors can be easily modified.-Model is fully textured with all materials applied.-All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.-3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.-No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.-No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.-No special plugin needed to open scene.-Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.
File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2014 V-Ray and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ (Multi Format)

  - 3DS (Multi Format)********************************

Warning: Depending on which software package you are using, the exchange formats (.obj, .3ds and .fbx) may not match the preview 
images exactly. Due to the nature of these formats, there may be some textures that have to be loaded by hand and possibly 
triangulated geometry.
Textures Formats:JPEG (.jpg)(2) 2500 x 2500
Hope you like it!

description_text:
Can opener 3D Model, nr. 2 in my collection. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 9632 vertices, 9622 quad faces (19244 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

Door is openable and separated, inside tray can be rotated or taken out and both knobs (temperature control and timer) are functional. All pivots are positioned properly for animations and rotations.
Available formats: .OBJ, .FBX, .3DS
Texture maps: Base color, metallic, roughness, normal, ambient occlusion, opacity (for glass tray)Format: Lossless .PNG (8bits/channel)Resolution: 2K (crisp clear from close-up, decrease as needed)
The asset was created with 3DS Max, high-poly sculpted with ZBrush, textured with Substance Painter.
Should you have any questions in regards with any of my products, don't hesitate to contact me here!

description_text:
Teapot 3D Model, nr. 2 in my collection. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 21989 vertices, 21673 quad faces (43346 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
eBook reader 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 3622 vertices, 3613 quad faces (7226 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Food beverage trolley cart 3D Model. 2 individual objects (frame, glass), each one with its own non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 33280 vertices, 33300 quad faces (66600 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

This model contains five simple floor tiles.
The tiles are simple lowpoly squares(4 vertex each) , UV mapped.
Texture Related:Eahc model has a set of 6 texture maps.
The high resoution textures are in 2K, and are the following:

  - Normal map

  - Bent normal map

  - Convexity map

  - Directions map (vertex displacement)

  - Heights map (bump)

  - Ambient occlusion (AO)

(The maps are in .exr format)
I did not include a diffuse texture, since you will most certainly use yours from your asset, to fit your scene.
Although the pictures were rendered using a FastSS2 marble preset with theese maps applied.
Model related:The models are all lowpoly models, consisting of a 4 vertex square, with UV maps applied.
I also included the highpoly mesh exports from Zbrush, in case you want to use them.
The models are in .obj / .3ds / .fbx formats. The lowpoly objects are interchangeable, you just need to change the texture.

description_text:
This building has 4 residential floors with medium range priced apartments with floor-to-ceiling windows for bright interior spaces, large balconies with secured glass railing and a huge terrace for the apartments on the first floor. The terrace has an exterior-treated wooden structure designed to make a customisable garden, suitable for hanging plants too. The first floor terrace is divided for the two apartments, having 64 and 77 sqm. The apartments on the upper floors also have large balconies, at 6 and 12 sqm. You can also see the wooden grilles on the sides of the building which do not only have a decorative role but they also cover the large bathroom windows for gaining extra privacy in case there exists an another building close enough. The windows are made of reflective mirror style glass, not allowing to see from the outside in.
The ground floor was designed as a commercial space with mixt use, suitable for a small neighbourhood supermarket, having a surface of 406 sqm. Considering it would be a commercial space, this is why it has very large windows but also a blank wall on the eastern side, suitable for creating a logistical entrance.
The download file is a .zip archive where you will find the project, the textures used and the photos above. The model was rendered using Raylectron.
